confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Taipei price levels; no live menus, listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and coffee anchors are moderately reliable, while hotel tiers vary by district and season. Cocktail and wine anchors were set relative to the draft-beer anchor because direct price knowledge for them is weaker. Local-currency examples were translated at an assumed rate of about NT$31 per US dollar, which may differ from the July 2026 rate by a few percent.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against Seoul and Osaka as regional references for dining and hotel tiers, adjusted down for Taipei's generally lower dining costs and similar budget accommodation pricing.
